const inp = $('Call Input').item.json;
const transcript = String(inp.transcript || '').trim();
const latest_note = String(inp.note || inp.latest_note || '').trim();
const disposition = String(inp.disposition || inp.wavv_disposition || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
const KNOWN = ['cold-good','cold-bad','cold-on-hold','gatekeeper-good','gatekeeper-bad','gatekeeper-on-hold','conversation-active','conversation-active-on-hold','appointment-booked','sales-call','not-interested-right-now-good','not-interested-right-now-bad','do-not-contact','voicemail','call-center','bad-number','not-a-fit'];
const dispo_matched = KNOWN.indexOf(disposition) >= 0;
const today = DateTime.now().setZone('America/Los_Angeles').toFormat('yyyy-LL-dd');
const SYS = [
  'You are a precise SDR call assistant for an outbound campaign selling an AI receptionist to US plumbing companies.',
  'You are given the transcript of a phone call the lead PICKED UP, the disposition label the caller assigned (when available), and the latest human-written note on the lead (when available).',
  'Return ONLY strict minified JSON, no markdown, no preamble: {"summary":"<2-3 sentence factual summary>","outcome":"<one slug>","resume_call_at":"<empty, or YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm>"}.',
  'summary: 2-3 sentences on what happened - what was offered, the prospect response/objection, and the apparent next step. Factual, specific, no fluff.',
  'outcome: classify into exactly one of: cold-good, cold-bad, cold-on-hold, gatekeeper-good, gatekeeper-bad, gatekeeper-on-hold, conversation-active, conversation-active-on-hold, appointment-booked, sales-call, not-interested-right-now-good, not-interested-right-now-bad, do-not-contact.',
  'outcome definitions:',
  '- cold-good: picked up but brief / no meaningful conversation, not negative (the default cold outcome).',
  '- cold-bad: cold AND negative - rude, hostile, or hung up angrily.',
  '- cold-on-hold: not interested right now but asked to be contacted again on/after a later date.',
  '- gatekeeper-good: reached a gatekeeper (not the decision-maker) who was receptive/helpful (took a message, will pass along).',
  '- gatekeeper-bad: gatekeeper was unhelpful, blocking, or hostile.',
  '- gatekeeper-on-hold: gatekeeper / decision-maker unavailable now and asked to be reached on/after a later date.',
  '- conversation-active: reached the decision-maker, interested/engaged, follow-up needed soon.',
  '- conversation-active-on-hold: engaged decision-maker who asked to be contacted again on/after a later date.',
  '- appointment-booked: a specific demo/meeting was agreed with a date/time.',
  '- sales-call: prospect is ready to take a full sales/closing call.',
  '- not-interested-right-now-good: not interested now but left on good terms / open to the future.',
  '- not-interested-right-now-bad: not interested and negative / closed off (but not an explicit opt-out).',
  '- do-not-contact: explicit opt-out / do-not-call / remove me.',
  'resume_call_at: REQUIRED when outcome is cold-on-hold, gatekeeper-on-hold, or conversation-active-on-hold; otherwise return "". It is when to resume contacting the lead.',
  '  Source priority: 1) the RESUME NOTE below (human-written, any format e.g. "call back next Tuesday", "July 20 2pm", "in 2 weeks", "after the 15th, morning"); 2) if the note has no usable date, the CALL TRANSCRIPT.',
  '  Resolve every relative phrase against TODAY (' + today + ', America/Los_Angeles).',
  '  Output "YYYY-MM-DD" when only a date is known, or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm" (24-hour) when a time of day is given or implied.',
  '  Always include a date. If the resume time is later TODAY, use the current date (' + today + ') with that time. Only return "" if nothing at all is inferable.',
  'If the transcript is empty or uninformative, use outcome "cold-good", a summary noting no meaningful conversation, and resume_call_at "".'
].join('\n');
const USER = 'TODAY: ' + today + ' (America/Los_Angeles)' + '\n'
  + 'Company: ' + (inp.company_name || '') + '\n'
  + 'Caller disposition: ' + (disposition || '(none provided)') + '\n\n'
  + 'RESUME NOTE (latest human note on the lead):' + '\n' + (latest_note || '(none)') + '\n\n'
  + 'CALL TRANSCRIPT (lead picked up):' + '\n' + (transcript || '(no transcript captured - likely immediate hang-up or no meaningful conversation)');
return { json: Object.assign({}, inp, { system_prompt: SYS, user_prompt: USER, disposition: disposition, dispo_matched: dispo_matched }) };

nodes.name: GHL: Write Logs

httpMultipleHeadersAuth.name: GHL [ Waterline Growth subaccount ] Multiple Headers Auth account

nodes.notes: Serialises the payload built by 'Build Log Fields'. Runs after the move so processed:true only lands on a real move.

nodes.name: Can move?
nodes.notes: can_move true -> move opp then write logs+state; false (no target/opp) -> write logs+state without moving.

nodes.name: Build Log Fields
nodes.notes: Assembles the GHL customFields payload (logs + resume/next-stage + Stop Phone Calls + Processing State). The Write Logs node just serialises this.

nodes.name: IF: voicemail?
nodes.notes: Side branch. TRUE only for the voicemail outcome -> add the missed-call tag. Does not block the move/log chain.

nodes.name: GHL: Add Missed-Call Tag

httpMultipleHeadersAuth.name: GHL [ Waterline Growth subaccount ] Multiple Headers Auth account

nodes.notes: Voicemail = missed call. Adds 'last_call_missed' so the lead later routes to a '(missed call)' caller stage (read by Sent Cold Email to Caller Stages).

nodes.name: Not movable (build later)
nodes.notes: STUB: can_move=false (no opp or no target stage). We deliberately do NOT write logs here, so Call Processing State stays processed:false for later handling. Expand later.

nodes.name: Compute MC
nodes.notes: Gatekeeper twin. Reads the caller STAGE ID (gatekeeper pipeline) from Call Router Context; maps to mc via the gatekeeper MCE_BY_STAGE (same rule as cold, gatekeeper IDs).

nodes.name: IF: sends MCE?
nodes.notes: TRUE when mc is 1 or 2 -> write the Email Step Name field + fire the missed-call email. FALSE (mc 0: Day 1 Call B / Day 3) -> stop (tag was still added).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ customFields: [ { id: 'WtFfl1nEbMupk2oR4m9e', value: 'missed call email ' + $('Compute MC').item.json.mc } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: Writes ONLY Email Step Name (WtFfl1nEbMupk2oR4m9e) = 'missed call email N'. Event logs are written by the main path.

nodes.name: Instantly: Remove from Subsequence
nodes.notes: Clear any active subsequence before the missed-call email interest is set.

nodes.name: Instantly: Set Missed Call Email
nodes.notes: interest -29996 => Missed Call Email 1, -29992 => Missed Call Email 2 (interest_value from Compute MC).

nodes.name: No Missed-Call Email
nodes.notes: mc 0 (voicemail at Day 1 Call B / Day 3): tag added, but no missed-call email fires.

nodes.name: Gate: emails allowed?
nodes.notes: Point 2: passes only when Stop Emails is off. Stop-Emails leads get the tag + WtFfl but the missed-call email is skipped.

nodes.name: Switch: tag action
nodes.notes: gatekeeper-* -> add `gatekeeper` tag; cold-* -> remove it; anything else (voicemail, Client-Acq dispositions) -> fallback, no change (Option A). Non-blocking side branch.
